website.note: Single-asset KRAS siRNA company (SIL204); pipeline content matches 10-K

ctgov.note: No SIL204 or Silexion-sponsored trials registered as of snapshot date

pipeline.modality: siRNA (small interfering RNA), local intratumoral and subcutaneous formulations
pipeline.target: KRAS (pan-KRAS G12 mutations including G12D, G12V; broad activity vs. oncogenic KRAS mutants)

indications.indication: Locally Advanced Pancreatic Cancer (LAPC) harboring KRAS mutation
indications.trial_name: SIL204-IR + Standard of Care chemotherapy vs SoC alone (adaptive design: Segment 1 P2 safety run-in, Segment 2 P2 dose-finding, Segment 3 confirmatory P3)
indications.trial_design: Prospective, randomized, controlled, multinational, multi-center, open-label, adaptive 3-segment design; ~15-21 patients in Segment 1, ~403 patients total; planned sites Israel + Germany + EU + US
indications.trial_status: PLANNED — Q2 2026 expected commencement. As of FY2025 10-K (filed 2026-03-17): submitted to Israel Ministry of Health (awaiting response); ethics committee approval received from major Israeli oncology center; German BfArM submission planned 03/2026; toxicology package complete; GMP API for Segment 1 manufactured.
key_milestones: 2025 H2: toxicology package complete in two species, ICH S9-aligned
Q1 2026: regulatory submission to Israel MoH
Planned H1 2027: file for Orphan Drug Designation in US and EU

excluded_preclinical.stage: Preclinical — additional indications planned for 2026 pipeline expansion

excluded_legacy_terminated.note: Phase II in LAPC completed 2018-2023 (5 sites Israel, 4 US); served as prototype for SIL204. Company pivoted from Loder to SIL204 in 2022 following management change; first-gen Loder no longer being developed for commercialization.
